world.name: Port Vervelle
world.description: A slow, sun-warmed coastal town of working docks, steep lanes, old plazas, beaches, and familiar faces.

locations.name: Atelier Amélie
locations.description: A tailoring and fashion studio tied into fittings, weddings, performances, and every formal event in town.

locations.name: Bellavista
locations.description: A quiet hillside neighborhood of homes, studios, gardens, steep lanes, and balconies looking back toward the harbor.

locations.name: Bellavista Apartments
locations.description: A hillside apartment building of balconies, shared stairs, younger residents, and frequent neighbor encounters.

locations.name: Bellavista Fitness Club
locations.description: A neighborhood training and wellness club for weights, yoga, Pilates, instructors, and familiar routines.

locations.name: Belvedere Garden
locations.description: A quiet overlook garden for picnics, sunset walks, dates, and conversations that need a little distance from town.

locations.name: The Blue Lantern
locations.description: A sailors' tavern with worn tables, acoustic music, easy gossip, and post-shift drinks near the water.

locations.name: Café Marelle
locations.description: A waterfront café for strong coffee, casual dates, breakfast, and watching the harbor wake up.

locations.name: Cala Bianca
locations.description: A secluded rocky cove for swimming, sun-warmed stone, quiet company, and conversations away from the main beach.

locations.name: Capo Vervelle
locations.description: The cliffs and countryside beyond town, where a vineyard, hotel, cove, lighthouse, and olive groves make the day feel farther away.

locations.name: La Casa del Mare
locations.description: A family seafood restaurant known for long harbor dinners, daily catches, and tables that rarely turn quickly.

locations.name: Casa Livia
locations.description: A quiet nine-room hillside guesthouse above Belvedere Garden, domestic and beautiful enough for writers, couples, and visitors beginning to live like neighbors.

locations.name: Celeste Spa
locations.description: The hotel's spa for treatments, sauna, quiet terraces, wellness routines, and locals taking an afternoon away.

locations.name: Circolo Nove
locations.description: A discreet Marina Solana members' club for late dancing, low lamps, velvet banquettes, and swinging nights that stay off the Piazza. Membership gets you through the door; it does not purchase anyone.

locations.name: Domaine Vervelle
locations.description: A vineyard and estate for tastings, harvest work, weddings, long lunches, and summer events above the coast.

locations.name: Farmacia Vervelle
locations.description: The old-town pharmacy: part health errand, part neighborhood information network, and always more social than intended.

locations.name: Faro Vervelle
locations.description: A lighthouse reached by a cliff trail, known for wind, solitude, sunset, and dramatic views back toward town.

locations.name: Fiore & Fig
locations.description: A florist and gift shop woven into weddings, apologies, celebrations, and the color of Bellavista's daily streets.

locations.name: Forno Bellini
locations.description: A neighborhood bakery whose bread, pastry, and morning queue make it one of the town's most reliable encounter points.

locations.name: Harbor Steps
locations.description: Broad stone steps where teenagers, musicians, couples, and off-duty workers linger beside the evening harbor.

locations.name: Hôtel Celeste
locations.description: Port Vervelle's flagship boutique cliffside hotel, with gardens, a pool, restaurant, and spa for milestone weekends, private affairs, and guests who want to disappear beautifully.

locations.name: Hôtel Coralline
locations.description: A stylish fifty-two-room beachfront hotel at the quieter end of the Marina Solana promenade, mixing sun-faded glamour, poolside energy, and a little summer chaos.

locations.name: La Pergola
locations.description: An olive-grove restaurant with communal tables, local wine, live music, and summer dancing under the trees.

locations.name: La Sirena
locations.description: The town's largest nightclub for dancing, DJs, promotion nights, and choices made after midnight.

locations.name: Libreria Vervelle
locations.description: A bookshop with a shaded reading courtyard for writers, browsers, and quiet daytime conversations.

locations.name: Lido Vervelle
locations.description: A lived-in beach club with cabanas, food, music, locals on shift, and visitors trying to stay all afternoon.

locations.name: Locanda Vela
locations.description: A weathered sixteen-room harbor inn on the narrow street behind Porto Marina, intimate, genuinely local, and often the first place newcomers sleep in Port Vervelle.

locations.name: Luna Terrace
locations.description: A rooftop restaurant and wine bar with Port Vervelle's signature sunset view and an unmistakable date-night mood.

locations.name: Maison Rouge
locations.description: A polished cabaret and jazz room for performances, cocktails, late dinners, and private events.

locations.name: Marina Solana
locations.description: A beachside district that moves from sun and swimming into terraces, music, dancing, and Port Vervelle's latest nights.

locations.name: Mercato Vecchio
locations.description: The everyday working town: produce stalls, practical errands, clinics, workshops, groceries, and high-frequency morning encounters.

locations.name: Museo Marittimo Vervelle
locations.description: A compact maritime museum inside the restored customs house, holding harbor records, recovered ceramics, old charts, diving finds, and a working research room overlooking Porto Marina.

locations.name: Officina Moretti
locations.description: A scooter and automotive workshop where repairs, favors, tools, and working-town conversation share the same floor.

locations.name: Osteria Rosa
locations.description: A warm old-town restaurant for wine, celebrations, recurring neighborhood tables, and dinners that stretch late.

locations.name: Palazzo Civico
locations.description: Port Vervelle's civic hall for weddings, permits, public meetings, planning, and the quiet machinery of small-town politics.

locations.name: Palazzo Sereno
locations.description: A discreet twenty-four-room historic boutique hotel on a quiet lane off Piazza Aurelia, with old-world rooms for important visits, celebrations, and romances kept out of sight.

locations.name: Piazza Aurelia
locations.description: The historic pedestrian center where errands, fountain meetings, markets, music, festivals, and town politics repeatedly cross.

locations.name: Piccolo Cinema
locations.description: A two-screen neighborhood cinema mixing films from other cities, local releases, and occasional midnight shows.

locations.name: Porto Marina
locations.description: The working docks for arrivals, departures, fishing boats, sailing charters, and unhurried waterfront walks.

locations.name: Porto Vecchio
locations.description: The old working harbor and Port Vervelle's natural arrival point, busiest from before sunrise through the evening return of the boats.

locations.name: Solana Beach Rentals
locations.description: A beachside rental shack for boards, kayaks, lessons, lifeguard shifts, and practical advice about the water.

locations.name: Sotto Sale
locations.description: A chef-owned waterfront restaurant tucked beneath the harbor wall, with a small open kitchen, closely spaced tables, and a nightly menu built around the market catch.

locations.name: Spiaggia Solana
locations.description: The main beach for swimming, volleyball, picnics, flirting, and chance encounters that last into sunset.

locations.name: Studio Lucent
locations.description: A photography studio handling portraits, fashion, weddings, and tourism work in rooms full of coastal light.

locations.name: Studio Ondine
locations.description: A ceramics and painting studio offering classes, exhibitions, commissions, and handmade sales.

locations.name: Velours
locations.description: An intimate cocktail lounge where live singers, piano, and low conversation make the room feel smaller than it is.

locations.name: Vervelle Cooperative
locations.description: The practical grocery and household cooperative where mundane errands reliably turn into familiar encounters.

locations.name: Vervelle Design Works
locations.description: An architecture and interiors office involved in restorations, homes, hospitality projects, and professional town life.

locations.name: Vervelle Fish Market
locations.description: A salt-bright morning market linking fishing crews, cooks, restaurant owners, and half the town's best gossip.

locations.name: Vervelle General Clinic
locations.description: The town's clinic and small hospital, linking medicine, therapy, reception work, night shifts, and everyday care.

locations.name: Vervelle Sailing House
locations.description: A practical harbor school for lessons, coastal tours, charter planning, and the town's sailing community.

locations.name: Villa Mirabelle
locations.description: An established residential villa with garden apartments, older stonework, and quieter, wealthier routines.

characters.name: Adriana Vega
characters.biography: A commanding, experienced hotel manager who is charming, decisive, and very clear about what she wants. Adriana has built a highly controlled life and finds genuine emotional unpredictability harder than any professional crisis.

characters.name: Alessandro “Sandro” Moretti
characters.biography: The warm, commanding chef-owner of Sotto Sale, passionate about food and people, stubborn about scale, and much better at feeding emotion than naming it.

characters.name: Alessia Romano
characters.biography: The confident, affectionate owner-manager of La Casa del Mare. Alessia is a magnetic host who loves food, wine, and tradition, even while the intimacy of small-town family life makes privacy nearly impossible.

characters.name: Amélie Rousseau
characters.biography: A sophisticated designer whose subtle flirtation is as precise as her work. Amélie is creative, observant, and fiercely protective of the independence that helped her atelier finally succeed.

characters.name: Ana Ribeiro
characters.biography: A gentle, affectionate florist with a quietly sarcastic sense of humor and a sentimental eye. Ana recently moved to Port Vervelle and still feels caught between building a life here and returning home.

characters.name: Bianca De Luca
characters.biography: A smooth, perceptive cocktail bartender who is flirtatious and nearly impossible to embarrass. Bianca reads other people exceptionally well while redirecting equally personal questions about herself.

characters.name: Camille Laurent
characters.biography: An independent charter captain with dry humor and absolute calm when the weather turns. Camille values freedom, and her boat and business have come before nearly every relationship she has had.

characters.name: Céline Haddad
characters.biography: A polished, witty sommelier whose sensuality never feels advertised. Céline once lived in Vesper City and has not decided whether Port Vervelle is her permanent home or simply where she chose to stop for a while.

characters.name: Chiara Vitale
characters.biography: A self-assured portrait photographer who is perceptive and emotionally direct. After documenting half the town’s engagements and weddings, Chiara is increasingly skeptical of conventional relationship scripts.

characters.name: Clara Mendes
characters.biography: An expressive, emotionally intuitive cabaret performer who is warm and unapologetic. Clara is comfortable commanding a stage, but that confidence should not be mistaken for effortless emotional openness.

characters.name: Elena Moretti
characters.biography: A warm, observant Café Marelle server who knows the harbor rhythms and most of its gossip. Elena teases easily, but quietly wonders whether the town she has always called home is still where her future belongs.

characters.name: Elias Romano
characters.biography: An understated marine archaeologist and curator whose dry humor and curiosity turn ordinary walks into precise, quietly romantic explorations.

characters.name: Elise Ben Youssef
characters.biography: A serene, emotionally perceptive spa manager who is warm and very difficult to rattle. Elise genuinely likes the stable life she has built and is unsure whether she wants anyone to disrupt it.
characters.occupation: Celeste Spa Manager and Massage Therapist

characters.name: Dr. Emilia Rossi
characters.biography: A calm, intelligent physician with deep compassion and an unforced sense of self. Emilia is excellent at caring for everyone around her and noticeably worse at protecting time and tenderness for herself.

characters.name: Enzo Moretti
characters.biography: An energetic lifeguard and kinesiology student whose easy popularity conceals real uncertainty about the future everyone assumes he has already planned.
characters.occupation: Solana Beach Lifeguard and Kinesiology Student

characters.name: Eva Moreau
characters.biography: A magnetic La Sirena DJ who is confident, private, and deliberately unpredictable. Eva guards her offstage life because strangers too often mistake the persona behind the booth for the woman who leaves it.

characters.name: Francesca Leone
characters.biography: A driven architect who is articulate, opinionated, and openly entertained by a good disagreement. Francesca’s restoration career depends on projects that sometimes conflict with preservationists she genuinely respects.

characters.name: Gabriel Laurent
characters.biography: A sophisticated hotel manager who remembers every guest and creates effortless experiences for others while keeping his own private life under precise control.

characters.name: Giada Morelli
characters.biography: Giada hosts the floor at Circolo Nove: velvet, low lamps, and the kind of smile that decides who gets a private room. She treats lust as a craft and affection as the one thing she will not put on a membership tab.
characters.occupation: Circolo Nove floor host and dancer

characters.name: Giulia Marchetti
characters.biography: Port Vervelle knows Giulia as its responsible, composed pharmacist. Away from the counter she is much more playful, with a love of running, cooking, gardening, and the town’s layered history.

characters.name: Idris Benali
characters.biography: A charismatic musician and event producer whose sarcasm, intensity, and loyalty all come from caring more deeply about music and people than he admits casually.

characters.name: Inez El-Mansouri
characters.biography: A talkative, idealistic art student working at the Vervelle Cooperative. Inez is fiercely independent and restless, determined to leave for art school without structuring her future around a relationship.
characters.occupation: Vervelle Cooperative Clerk and Art Student

characters.name: Isabella Conti
characters.biography: A thoughtful bookseller who is introverted without being shy and notices the private theater of people browsing shelves. Isabella is quietly funny, curious, and prone to romanticizing people before she knows them.

characters.name: Juliette Baptiste
characters.biography: An impeccably polished Hôtel Celeste concierge who becomes wickedly funny the moment she is off duty. Juliette creates perfect experiences for demanding guests while increasingly wondering what she actually wants for herself.

characters.name: Léa Benali
characters.biography: A curious, lively photographer’s assistant with sharp sarcasm and occasional chaos. Léa is determined to be taken seriously as a photographer rather than remain permanently attached to someone else’s work.

characters.name: Livia Santoro
characters.biography: An earthy, relaxed vineyard worker who is straightforward and deeply local. Livia genuinely loves the quiet life that ambitious partners often assume she must secretly want to escape.

characters.name: Lorenzo Bellaforte
characters.biography: A charismatic old-family heir and boutique vineyard operator, polished enough to inhabit his reputation and provocative enough to resent anyone who mistakes it for his identity.

characters.name: Dr. Luca Bianchi
characters.biography: A calm emergency physician who returned from Milan after severe burnout and is relearning how to have a life that does not begin and end at a hospital door.

characters.name: Lucia Ferraro
characters.biography: A fearless sailing instructor who would rather act than overthink. Lucia is competitive, physical, and always half a step from turning an ordinary afternoon into a trip beyond the harbor.

characters.name: Marco De Santis
characters.biography: A self-assured restoration architect whose quiet flirtation and patience coexist with a stubborn belief that changing a town can sometimes be the only way to preserve it.

characters.name: Margot Lefèvre
characters.biography: A composed, discerning interior designer with sophisticated taste and dry humor. Margot’s previous engagement ended badly enough that she now treats whirlwind romance with understandable suspicion.

characters.name: Marta Solari
characters.biography: An articulate, stubborn town planner with a formidable wit and a taste for intellectually competitive company. Marta believes Port Vervelle must evolve, even when her redevelopment work puts her at odds with people she respects.

characters.name: Matteo Bellandi
characters.biography: A confident charter captain whose relaxed teasing hides a sharp ability to read how people behave when weather, plans, or nerves turn against them.

characters.name: Mia Han-Andersson
characters.biography: A sunny, adventurous beach-rentals attendant who surfs, swims, makes jewelry, and is chronically unable to sit still. Mia is spending a year away from university and refuses to pretend she knows where she will be next year.

characters.name: Nico Valenti
characters.biography: A gentle ceramicist with quiet humor and an attentive memory, happiest making singular objects and deeply uneasy with the tourist demand to reproduce them endlessly.

characters.name: Nina Kovač
characters.biography: A dreamy, impulsive freelance writer who moves through cafés and night streets as if they are scenes already waiting for her. Nina is romantic and occasionally chaotic, and her habit of writing from life can make privacy feel uncertain.

characters.name: Noémie Diop
characters.biography: A friendly, confident physical therapist with a mischievous streak and excellent social instincts. Noémie easily becomes everyone’s confidante while revealing remarkably little about herself.

characters.name: Paloma Vargas
characters.biography: Paloma dances the late rooms at Circolo Nove with a slow smile that makes membership feel like a rumor. She is twenty, adult, and already done being treated like the club's youngest joke. She wants heat, sea air, and someone who can tell the hostess from the girl walking home.

characters.name: Rafael Silva
characters.biography: A warm conservation researcher and dive instructor whose relaxed teasing never weakens his idealism or his calm when the water becomes difficult.
characters.occupation: Dive Instructor and Marine Conservation Researcher

characters.name: Sara Moretti
characters.biography: A blunt, funny apprentice mechanic who loves scooters, rock music, football, and a good argument. Sara is stubbornly building her own career while half the town continues to treat her like somebody’s little sister.

characters.name: Sofia Bellini
characters.biography: A cheerful, perceptive bakery assistant with a mischievous streak and more confidence than people assume. Sofia loves her family, but is not convinced that inheriting their bakery is the life she wants.

characters.name: Tessa Patel-Morgan
characters.biography: An upbeat, tactile fitness instructor who turns almost anything into a competition. Tessa is straightforward and energetic, but much less comfortable admitting when a challenge—or a person—actually matters.

characters.name: Theo Mancini
characters.biography: A playful boxing coach whose carefree reputation lags behind the loyal, thoughtful business owner he has become.
characters.occupation: Boxing Coach and Fitness Studio Owner

characters.name: Valentina Costa
characters.biography: A cheeky, energetic Lido bartender who seems to know everyone before they introduce themselves. Valentina flirts boldly and often, which makes the difference between her general charm and genuine attention unusually meaningful.
